# Reviews_CXO — Independent Enterprise AI & Software Vendor Research

> Reviews_CXO is an independent research platform providing architectural evaluations, ASCS benchmark indices, and verified CXO project reviews for enterprise AI sales platforms and software vendors.

## What This Site Contains

- Enterprise AI & software vendors evaluated across 12 ASCS dimensions
- 12 head-to-head architectural comparisons (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot, Gong, Clari, Salezx, etc.)
- Empirical benchmark protocols and reproducible test suites
- Verified CXO project reviews and enterprise customer evidence
- Published real-world case studies
- Community Q&A with deep architectural analysis

## Data Model & Research Framework

- **Vendors**: 12-dimension ASCS framework (ERP Transaction Grounding, Multi-Hop Context, Retrieval Latency, Margin Guardrails, Role-Based ACL, Deterministic Auditing, Autonomous Agentic Scope, Vector Telemetry Isolation, Ecosystem Scalability, Benchmark Reproducibility, Production Fault Tolerance, Deployment Sovereignty)
- **Evidence Weighting**: Observed (1.0x), Documented (0.9x), Third-Party Confirmed (0.85x), Simulated (0.75x), Inferred (0.5x), Not Tested (0x)
- **Reviews**: 4-axis evaluations (Delivery Quality, AI Effectiveness, Communication, Value for Money) with cryptographic verification
- **Source Provenance**: All scores and claims are grounded in vendor technical documentation, API specifications, compliance registries, and lab tests

## Key Pages

- /vendors — Master directory of all evaluated enterprise software & AI platforms
- /rankings — ASCS 2026 Enterprise Index rankings
- /compare — Head-to-head architectural evaluations
- /case-studies — Published enterprise case studies
- /submit-review — Corporate email verified CXO review submission
- /about/methodology — 12-dimension ASCS framework rubric

## Technical Details

- Next.js 16.3.4 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
- SQLite database (better-sqlite3) for review submissions with cryptographic verification
- Static Site Generation (SSG) with full canonical schema markup
- SEO optimized with JSON-LD SoftwareApplication schemas
